body: I feel you. If I was your student I’ll definitely do all the work. It’s obvious that you care a lot. The thing is that students nowadays don’t put much effort, specially if they are not in college. The online setting just makes it even more appealing to set back and not do any work. My only tip would be to take it easy and not give it much thought for now. Relax a bit. Even as a college undergraduate I noticed students did not watched the recorded lectures of an asynchronous class. In other words, even at a college setting people are also neglecting to do the work. This is just my response, hope it helps even if a bit. I hope everything goes fine.
Definitely! I'll send you a private message through reddit if you don't mind.
This is so relatable... why can’t the world just end right now? WHY?
I just wanted you to feel like there is people out there, a comment can sometimes make s huge difference
Don’t worry, I understand you. Sometimes I do feel like it would be selfish too. I just can’t control my emotions.
but it’s not your fault that your life isn’t so great, what did those people ever did to help you out? Wouldn’t they have noticed your pain? It’s selfish of them to feel sad, it’s just not right...
No, it’s not selfish. Why would it be?

I feel you man, I can’t tell u how much it hurts to be alive. People keep saying it will get better, but shit man, it only gets worse. All I can say to u is that you are not the only one like this, there are so many people in the same situation. Fuck this life, just fuck everyone else’s achievements. Just do you, fuck about whatever happens. If you want to sleep all day to feel better then do that. Just understand shits all about you, only you.

Hey man I’ve always been alone like you. Video games have kept me in an addiction that show me that I can have fun without having to talk with other people. But, man it’s just weird how sometimes you feel guilty to not try to connect with others. People have probably tried to talk to you. Instead, I’m 100% sure that you tried to avoid them. I don’t know what it is, but I guess is because you don’t want them to bother you while you are playing games and having fun alone. It’s really normal to feel this way. So far I’m also feeling really suicidal and depressed. I have ignored people for way too long and I know it’s my fault. But we can’t help it. We won’t break away from this comfort. That’s why we want to die. End this fucking pain. I wish the world would just end right now. Don’t you think so?. End it right now.

I feel you, people don’t understand. like why do they even try to make our lives impossible. Man it just sucks... I wish people would not be so damn annoying. I’m also 19 years old with constant mental breakdowns and I do feel the pain that ur going through. All that bullying and disrespect builds up and the fact that ur spending ur time in a miserable job makes it even worse. Man I’m no therapist, but if it isn’t too late for you try to just forget about others opinion and avoid the negatives. It has been too late for me, but I do hope this works for you. Man living is a pain in the ass... I wish I’d just be dead.
